regions.region: page 8 upper and middle Scheme 5A reaction header, product grid, ORTEP, and caption
regions.finding: Inspected all eleven displayed products. The 4aa row is the same 0.2 mmol isolated repeat already reported parenthetically for Table 1 entry 8 and was merged; 4b–4k are ten distinct scope experiments with shared catalyst/reagent/base/additive/solvent/temperature, isolated yields, crude-NMR regioisomeric ratios, and chiral-HPLC ee values. The 4h ORTEP is characterization, not another preparation.

Retained two separate Sakurai reactions from 4aa: i-PrCHO/TiCl4/CH2Cl2 at −78 °C gives 7g (40%, >10:1 dr, 96% ee), and CyCHO/TsNH2/TMSOTf/EtCN at −78 °C gives 7h (53%, 2.6:1 dr, 97% ee). Caption measurement bases and the 0.2 mmol scale are retained; missing equivalents and time remain null.
